text:
luis: Quick sync — thinking about a small SI accelerator we push through Azure + AWS marketplaces. idea: private offer with 20% off year-1 consumption for customers who commit 12mo, plus a 10% renewal credit applied as marketplace credits at renewal. early-pay (prepay 6mo) gets +5% one-time bonus credit. thoughts?

ava: i like the two-phased incentive. keeps runway & encourages renewals. curious on margin impact though.

jamal: from field — SI partners love upfront credits. but they want easy co-sell workflows and a clear SKU mapping. we should avoid messy split invoicing.

maria_finance: ping @luis @ava — need to model net ARR impact. rough calc: 20% off yr1 + 10% renewal credit effectively ~ 28% gross reduction over 2 yrs depending on usage. send me sample deal sizes and consumption curve.

sofia_legal: heads-up on marketplace contract language. renewal credits can’t be framed as rebates in some clouds; need explicit marketplace credit mechanics + audit clause. also add a clause preventing stacking with other promos.

luis: noted — i'll draft terms. jamal, can you share typical deal sizes (3 buckets: pilot <$50k, mid $50-250k, enterprise >250k)?

jamal: will share by EOD. quick ask — can the SI get a referral fee out of the credits or must that be separate cash comp?

ava: prefer referral cash outside of marketplace credits — simplifies accounting for partners. can propose a partner rebate program (fixed % per closed commit) paid quarterly.

maria_finance: agreed. marketplace credits should be tracked as contra-revenue; partner rebates as partner expense. we can automate accruals if we get SKU mapping.

marketplace-bot: New doc: https://redwood-internal/docs/marketplace/si-accelerator-draft-v1 — please add comments by Fri.

luis: putting a short offer template here for feedback:
```
Offer: SI Accelerator Private Offer
- Eligibility: SI-backed deals closed via Marketplace Listing
- Term: 12 months commit (consumption)
- Year 1: 20% consumption credit applied as marketplace credit
- Renewal: 10% credit (applied on renewal invoice)
- Early-pay: additional 5% one-time credit for prepay >= 6 months
- Partner comp: separate rebate (negotiated) paid outside marketplace
- Limits: not combinable with other promos; cap $500k credits per account unless approved
```

sofia_legal: small tweak: specify redemption window and audit rights. also require partner attestation that SI delivered onboarding.

maria_finance: also add a clause for clawback if usage falls <70% of committed baseline in first 3 months.

ava: sounds good. next steps: jamal to provide deal buckets, luis to update draft with legal + finance comments, marketplace team to validate listing mechanics. can we aim for partner pilot next month? :calendar:

jamal: yep, will share buckets today. I'm optimistic partners will push this. :rocket:

luis: great — i'll update the doc and loop in partner ops for launch checklist. thanks all! :tada:
